thread:
maria: CI perf alert on canary after the merge to main this morning — p95/p99 token latency up ~18% on long-context generation tests. Should we block rollout? :frowning:
liam: which merge/PR? link please
maria: PR #4821 (kernel selector heuristic tweak) merged ~07:10 UTC. Commit a1b2c3d. CI started failing 07:15. here's the CI job: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821/12 :eyes:
sophie: I ran a quick bisect locally. suspect the new fallback selection for quantized paths picks `matmul_v2_fallback` at seq_len>1024, which is slower on A100 for our kernel shapes. snippet from my run: `selector: input_len=1536, model=redwood-7b-q4, chosen_kernel=matmul_v2_fallback, est_ms=2.9`
raj: adding that I'm seeing more KV cache churn in traces — cache misses up from ~3% to ~11% on the same workload. hypothesis: fallback forces a codepath that invalidates cached KV layout leading to recompute.
liam: rough plan: either revert the selector change on main or cherry-pick a guard into release-1.9 that preserves old selector for quantized models while we iterate.
sophie: I prepared a candidate patch that adds the guard and falls back to previous kernel for q4 models: cherry-pick `a1b2c3d` -> `release-1.9` restores perf locally. local perf harness:
```
$ git checkout release-1.9
$ git cherry-pick a1b2c3d
$ make perf-harness && ./perf_harness --model redwood-7b-q4 --seq-len 1536 --tokens 20000
p95 latency: 102ms (baseline 100ms), p99: 140ms (baseline 135ms)
KV miss rate: 3.1% (regressed -> fixed)
```
ops-bot: ISSUE_CREATED: INF-987: "Canary perf regression after selector heuristic merge" (assignee: eng-runtime)
maria: good. verification checklist: 1) run gated perf suite on release-1.9 (long-context, seqlen 2048, quantized+fp16 variants), 2) smoke deploy to single-node canary, 3) synthetic load for 10k tokens, 4) validate p95/p99 within 5% of baseline and KV miss <5%, 5) check GPU util and tail-latency traces.
raj: kicking off the gated perf job now, will post artifacts. I'll also run a short KV probe harness to confirm miss rate.
liam: if perf job green, I can approve and push the cherry-pick branch. who will do the cut and deploy?
sophie: I can push the branch and open the hotfix PR to release-1.9. test run on my machine shows p95 ~1.02x baseline and KV miss down to 3%. attaching brief summary: perf/1729991111/summary.txt
raj: perf artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/perf/1729991111/report.html — key numbers: p95 ratio 1.02, p99 ratio 1.04, KV miss 3.0% (was 12.1% with the change). Looks good to me.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: release-1.9-hotfix-a1b2c3d -> canary at 2026-03-18T12:35:00Z (initiator: sophie)
maria: canary looks stable after 30m. monitoring shows no tail spikes. schedule staged rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 15m watch windows. tagging @sre-oncall for visibility.
liam: :thumbsup: I'll monitor dashboards and be ready to revert. thanks everyone for quick response.
sophie: once rollout finishes, let's add a small regression test to CI that runs long-context perf for q4 models to catch this earlier.
maria: agreed — ticket created INF-988 for long-context q4 perf test. closing loop here, feel free to DM if anything pops up. :party_parrot:
